description: This file is a C source file implementing core WiFi data plane processing, including handling of WiFi frames (802.1x, auth, association request/response), processing timeouts, event handling, and thread management for data packet processing in a WiFi module.

methods.name: void process_timeout()
methods.description: Handles periodic timeout processing, including passpoint and 802.1X data timeouts.

methods.name: void process_packet_timeout(wifi_data_plane_packet_t * packet,wifi_data_plane_t * module)
methods.description: Processes timeout for a specific data packet based on its type.

methods.name: void process_event_timeout(wifi_data_plane_event_t * event,wifi_data_plane_t * module)
methods.description: Handles timeout events, including DPP and passpoint events.

methods.name: void process_packet(wifi_data_plane_packet_t * packet,wifi_data_plane_t * module)
methods.description: Processes incoming data packets based on their type (e.g., 802.1x, auth, assoc req/rsp).

methods.name: void process_event(wifi_data_plane_event_t * event,wifi_data_plane_t * module)
methods.description: Processes events based on their type, such as passpoint or DPP events.

methods.name: void * process_data_plane_function(void * data)
methods.description: Main thread function for processing queued data packets and events, handling timeouts and signaling.

methods.name: void assoc_rsp_frame_sent(unsigned int ap_index,mac_address_t sta,void * data,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Handles the event when an association response frame is sent, queues the data.

methods.name: void assoc_req_frame_received(unsigned int ap_index,mac_address_t sta,void * data,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Handles receipt of an association request frame, queues the data.

methods.name: void auth_frame_sent(unsigned int ap_index,mac_address_t sta,void * data,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Queues the data when an authentication frame is sent.

methods.name: void auth_frame_received(unsigned int ap_index,mac_address_t sta,void * data,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Queues the data when an authentication frame is received.

methods.description: Placeholder for processing EAPOL frame sent, currently commented out.

methods.name: void eapol_frame_received(unsigned int ap_index,mac_address_t sta,wifi_eapol_type_t type,void * data,unsigned int len)
methods.description: Handles receipt of an EAPOL frame, queues the data.

methods.name: void deinit_wifi_data_plane()
methods.description: Deinitializes the data plane module, cleans up resources.

methods.name: int init_wifi_data_plane()
methods.description: Initializes the data plane module, sets up queues, thread, and related resources.

methods.name: bool data_plane_queue_check_event(wifi_data_plane_event_type_t type,void * ctx)
methods.description: Checks if a specific event type and context already exists in the queue.

methods.name: void * data_plane_queue_remove_event(wifi_data_plane_event_type_t type,void * ctx)
methods.description: Removes an event of specified type and context from the queue, returns the event context.

methods.description: Creates a data packet object for queueing.

methods.description: Creates an event object for queueing.
